as_of_policy.annual: exact selected cohort observation; ancestor profiles bounded by verified pre-2026 annual member dates
as_of_policy.daily: latest selected profile archive observation date; no historical reconstruction
as_of_policy.depth_definition: sire/dam direct edge is generation 1; direct BMS is generation 2; overall graph uses only sire/dam paths
as_of_policy.horse_unit: earliest scanned 2026 entry date; any/all safe-entry counts also supplied
as_of_policy.parent_edges: child and canonical parent profiles must both be available
as_of_policy.temporal_precision: date inclusive; intra-day publication times not verified

declared_new_race_first_appearance.definition: first scanned entry has BAC A1/A2; not independently proven debut

execution: local managed runtime; no Actions run claimed

scope.cancellations: UNKNOWN: no target-race result/cancellation evidence; declarations retained
scope.denominator_definition: KYI declared race-year entries, not confirmed actual starters
